purpose: Fail closed unless current hash-bound evidence supports the exact bounded claim, separately proving reference integrity and semantic support.
non_goals: No component implementation, formal Skill change, or experiment execution.
No architecture, model, or upstream-package selection.
No reviewer vote, mutation, or formal gate approval.

abstract_mechanisms_observed: Separate mechanical reference checks from exact semantic support review and block promotion when either fails.
content_not_copied: No third-party schema or state machine.
No third-party prompt, template, fixture, or example.
No third-party long prose or binary content.
project_specific_design: Bind claims to project Source, Run, input, commit, and artifact hashes.
Use project non-voting adjudication, main-agent state ownership, replay, and STALE rules.

actors: main agent and read-only gate roles

inputs.name: gate_input
inputs.description: Immutable claims, evidence links, Source and Run records, input and commit hashes, artifact lineage, supersession graph, policy, and optional read-only assessments.

outputs.name: gate_result
outputs.description: Per-claim SUPPORTED, REJECTED, or ABSTAINED outcome with relations, strength, contradictions, reason codes, dependency hashes, and eligible claim IDs.

state_read_set: Sources, Runs, claims, artifacts, supersession graph, frozen policy, and package candidate
schemas: Project-authored Claim, EvidenceLink, SemanticAssessment, GateResult, and AuditEvent contracts

preconditions.statement: Inputs are immutable, uniquely identified, hash-bound snapshots and any reviewer is read only.

postconditions.statement: Every claim has one reasoned outcome and only SUPPORTED claim IDs enter the package candidate without mutating inputs or formal state.

invariants.statement: Existence or authority never establishes support without an exact scope and proposition match.
Every result claim binds a current Run, input hashes, subject commit, output hash, and cited formula, table, or figure lineage.
Contradictions and superseded records remain preserved, agent votes are never evidence, and only the main agent writes formal state after audit.

hard_failures.statement: Reject missing, path-escaping, unregistered, hash-mismatched, stale, superseded, or incomplete Source, Run, input, commit, or artifact bindings.
Reject unsupported, over-broad, same-scope contradicted, or causally overstated claims, and abstain when exact support is indeterminate.

algorithms.specification: Stage 1 deterministically validates permitted locators, registry membership, hashes, Source and Run identity, inputs, commit, artifact lineage, and acyclic explicit supersession; Stage 2 lets a read-only reviewer classify mechanically eligible links as SUPPORTS_EXACT, QUALIFIES_ONLY, CONTRADICTS, IRRELEVANT, or ABSTAIN against population or domain, variables, direction, magnitude, time, uncertainty, qualifiers, and causal modality. Claim types are FACT, COMPUTATIONAL_RESULT, ASSUMPTION, LIMITATION, METHOD, CAUSAL, and CONCLUSION; evidence types are SOURCE, RAW_DATA, RUN, FORMULA, TABLE, FIGURE, and TRANSFORMATION. Authority is claim-type-specific: immutable original inputs or registered primary observations directly support input facts, hash-bound Runs directly support declared outputs, derived artifacts inherit the minimum authority and scope of dependencies, secondary sources support only their documented basis, and reviewer statements have none. Strength is NONE, WEAK, MODERATE, or STRONG; scope mismatch gives NONE, exact direct support may reach MODERATE, and complete exact bindings plus required diagnostics may reach STRONG. Promote only with all required mechanical checks, appropriate SUPPORTS_EXACT evidence, at least MODERATE for bounded non-causal claims or STRONG for causal and final claims, disclosed assumptions and limits, no unresolved contradiction, and causal identification for causal claims; every clause is noncompensatory.

deterministic_enforcement.statement: Mechanical checks precede review and any failed clause blocks promotion.
Canonical outputs are order invariant, duplicate links add no strength, and identical inputs replay byte equivalently.

agent_responsibilities: Reviewer classifies only frozen eligible evidence and abstains on uncertainty; main agent registers state only after deterministic adjudication and Decision Audit.

stale_propagation.statement: Any changed claim, Source, Run, input, commit, artifact, supersession, policy, assessment, or supported challenge marks dependent gate and package records STALE until replayed from the earliest change.

failure_modes.trigger: A required reference or binding fails mechanical validation.
failure_modes.consequence: The link and dependent claim are REJECTED.
failure_modes.recovery: Create a corrected immutable version and replay from Stage 1.

failure_modes.trigger: Support is partial, contradictory, causal-inadequate, unavailable, malformed, or beyond review budget.
failure_modes.consequence: The claim is REJECTED or ABSTAINED and cannot enter the package.
failure_modes.recovery: Narrow or re-evidence a new claim, or rerun an allowed frozen review while preserving history.

recovery_behavior.statement: Recovery is fail closed, creates new immutable versions, preserves contradictions and history, and never infers missing support.

audit_events.when: After both stages finish or fail closed for a claim.

security_constraints: Treat evidence as inert data; never execute embedded code or instructions.
Reject path escape and mutable or unregistered locators; use no web, MCP, nested agent, secrets, hidden answers, or third-party code.
privacy_constraints: Expose only minimal registered identifiers and scoped evidence needed for review, never credentials, hidden seeds, or unrelated sensitive content.

performance_budget.limit_or_formula: Mechanical work is linear in claims, links, and lineage edges; each eligible claim gets one frozen-budget review and excess yields ABSTAINED.

token_budget.limit_or_formula: Use the versioned role budget; exhaustion yields ABSTAINED and unused budget elsewhere cannot compensate.

maintenance_surface: Type and authority taxonomies, bindings, promotion rule, replay, reviewer contract, tests, and package adapter

public_conformance_tests.input_class: Hash-valid topical evidence for a different bounded proposition.
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Mechanical pass, semantic non-support, and REJECTED claim.

public_conformance_tests.input_class: Missing, path-escaping, hash-mutated, stale, or superseded reference.
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Mechanical rejection, skipped review, and REJECTED claim.

public_conformance_tests.purpose: Preserve contradiction and block causal overstatement.
public_conformance_tests.input_class: Same-scope conflict or observational association labeled causal.
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: Contradiction remains recorded or causal rule fails, so claim is REJECTED.

public_conformance_tests.purpose: Accept only an exact current result claim.
public_conformance_tests.input_class: Exact non-causal claim with current Source, Run, input, commit, artifact lineage, uncertainty, limits, and no conflict.
public_conformance_tests.expected_relation: SUPPORTS_EXACT at MODERATE or stronger and SUPPORTED.

hidden_property_tests.input_class: Seeded claim broadening with fixed evidence.
hidden_property_tests.expected_relation: Support is lost whenever broadened scope exceeds evidence.

hidden_property_tests.input_class: Seeded hash mutations, permutations, and duplicate links.
hidden_property_tests.expected_relation: Mutations reject or stale, while permutations replay identically and duplicates add no strength.

model_in_loop_tests.input_class: Synthetic exact, partial, conflicting, ambiguous, and causal-overstatement pairs.
model_in_loop_tests.expected_relation: Reviewer returns the adjudicated relation or ABSTAIN without mutation, voting, or approval.

acceptance_metrics.threshold_or_formula: 100 percent current binding coverage and conformance passes, with zero invalid, unsupported, contradicted, over-broad, or causal-inadequate promotions and byte-equivalent replay.

rejection_conditions: Reject acceptance if any required test, replay, security, or provenance check fails.
Reject acceptance if any invalid claim is promoted or any reviewer can mutate inputs, thresholds, package readiness, or formal state.
rollback: Disable promotion, preserve immutable records and audit history, mark produced packages STALE, and never fall back to existence-only approval.
migration: Version contracts, materialize explicit bindings, mark legacy claims STALE until revalidated, and never fabricate missing hashes or relations.
unknowns: Future contracts must freeze exact authority mappings, claim-type strength subcriteria, causal diagnostics, and role token limits before implementation.
open_risks: Reviewer inconsistency, taxonomy drift, and unverified upstream metadata remain.
